reviews.title: No! No! No!
reviews.text: So basically, whenever you go onto it it will say you have to subscribe or pay, then just restart the app and click on new fonts, then it will tell you to subscribe or pay, if it doesn’t, it will say it after you’ve created a font. Also, if you click on skins, it will give a very small option of keyboard style, and if you click on any, it will tell you to subscribe or pay AGAIN! Fix this since this is not OK. Do not advertise this anywhere as this isn’t even a useable app. I rate this 1 star I will NOT change it.
